files.docs/research/csv.md:
# CSV output with zero data rows

With fieldnames set to name and quantity, csv.DictWriter.writeheader() writes a header row. Calling writerows([]) writes no data rows. A caller can invoke these operations separately. The current inventory stores item names and quantities locally.
